text:
marta: Heads up — main is red after the auto-dep PR merged. CI jobs failing in unit tests that hit config/model validation. Looks like the dependency bump was pydantic -> 2.1.0 from dependabot.

CI-bot: Job circleci/unit-tests #3145 failed on main (exit code 1). See <https://circleci.example/3145|details>.

josh: ugh. can you paste the failing trace? quick check if it's a new test failure vs API change.

marta: paste:```
E   TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'validate_all'

tests/unit/config/test_validation.py:23: TypeError
...
File "\/workspace\/lib\/config_models.py", line 42, in __init__
    super().__init__(**data)
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'validate_all'
```

marta: Seems like pydantic v2 removed some v1 kwargs. Our config models import patterns assume v1.

priya: Quick triage: can someone try a local reproduce with pydantic==2.1 and pydantic==1.10.12 to confirm regression? `pip install pydantic==2.1.0` then `pytest tests/unit/config/test_validation.py -q`

sam: I can run it now on my laptop. Running with 2.1 -> reproduces immediately. With 1.10.12 tests pass.

josh: OK that's definitive. Options: revert/force-pin to <2 for now, or fix code to support pydantic v2 (likely bigger change). For short-term unblock, pin to pydantic<2 in requirements and push a follow up to migrate.

alex: I'll open a revert PR to pin pydantic to <2 and bump the dependency properly in a later change. Would you all prefer a revert commit or a patch that edits requirements.in to add `pydantic<2,>=1.10.12`?

marta: Either is fine. Revert is fastest. We should also add a CI gate to block auto-upgrades for pydantic until we've audited.

josh: Agree. Also add a small test that imports `BaseModel` and checks presence of v1 APIs? Might be noisy but helpful.

alex: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/revert-pydantic-bump-abc123 -> will pin and run CI.

CI-bot: Manual rerun triggered for circleci/unit-tests #3145 by sam.

sam: rerun failed again (same trace). Not flaky, definitely API change.

marta: Thanks alex. After revert PR merges, rerun main and I'll watch. Also can someone add a note to the dependency whitelist that pydantic needs manual review?

alex: PR created and linked to issue #2345. I'll include a short note in the PR description to block bot bumps for pydantic.

josh: Once revert is merged, I'll follow up with a small migration plan for config_models to support v2 (if we want) or keep pinned for now.

marta: Perfect. Thanks everyone — keeping this labelling as sev-low but blocking main for a bit. :handshake:

alex: Revert merged — main CI retriggering.

CI-bot: circleci/unit-tests #3150 started (merge commit revert-pydantic-bump).

CI-bot: circleci/unit-tests #3150 succeeded.

marta: Green — thanks. We'll track long-term migration in #2345.
